An octopus is hiding something wild inside its body...
That is not a typo: three separate hearts.

Picture Kevin at the doctor. One heartbeat? Normal. Now picture the octopus. Two hearts pump blood through the gills, and the third one feeds the rest of the body. And when it swims, that third heart just... stops.
So swimming makes an octopus tired. That is why it prefers to crawl.
Like: I ran for the bus today. My one heart almost quit too.
